name: @game-hub/game-cantstop
description: Can't Stop as a single in-workspace game package — the Track D pilot retrofit (phase 2). Four subpath exports over TypeScript source: ./engine (pure rules core), ./module (backend GameModule with the dice-roll route + bot runner), ./client (UI GameClient), ./bot (AI risk model + difficulty tiers + self-play). Depends only on @game-hub/kernel (+ React for ./client, Fastify types for ./module).
